text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Council concerning an application by the property owner of 24 Cedar Ave for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-5.C of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner is seeking Council's permission to , which does not comply with stipulated by Section of the bylaw. The fence is installed along the west side lot line (abutting 22 Cedar Ave) and along the rear private laneway. The fence on the west side ranges from 2.3 m to 2.6 m (7 feet 7 inches to 8 feet 7 inches) in height and approximately 15 m (50 feet) wide. The rear yard fence post is the highest point of the fence at 3.0 m (10 feet) high and 8.4 m (27 feet 6 inches) wide. The fence material used is…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Grant the application for a fence exemption permit at 24 Cedar Avenue, with the following conditions; a. The fence installation shall be maintained in good repair without alteration. b. The fence in the rear yard along the south side of the private lane for a span of 8.3 metres shall be maintained at a height of 2.05 metres. c. The fence in the side yard along the west side of the property for a span of 14.85 metres (with slight grade change) shall be maintained at a height of 2.05 metres. d. At such time as replacement of the fence is required, that such installation will comply with Municipal Code, Chapter 447 or its successor by-law.
